We can’t wait to welcome you back on your next trip to Saigon. Safe travels, and thank you for choosing Eddie’s as part of your journey!

I loved Eddie's D2 New York Deli and Diner. It was my favorite restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City.
Mar 2024 • Solo
I loved Eddies D2 New York Deli and Diner!!! It seemed to come right out of 1950's or 1960's America. The interior design, seating, staff uniforms, food, music........everything!! They were all so authentic. I ordered a grilled cheese and ham sandwich and a chocolate milkshake. These two dishes were expertly prepared and tasted great. I also got fabulous service. The music in the place was also wonderful. I heard one classic 1950's and 1960's rock song after another and loved all of them. I had a really special experience at Eddie's D2 New York Deli and Diner.

Family Favourite
Dec 2023 • Family
Whenever we want to give the kids a 'treat' or they pick the place we eat they will nearly always pick Eddies. They adore it here. Not only due to the amazing food but also the general ambience and atmosphere. 

The staff are extremely friendly and polite and the setting is excellent. 

If anything the kids portions might be too generous but I would rather that than them leaving hungry. The other issue is there is too much choice in a way, we all want dessert and milkshakes and a range of other things (I guess it means we just have to keep coming back). 

I always go for the burger (with cheese and bacon) which has never disappointed me.

They do deliver but going out and sitting in the place is always better.
